bagPolicy.summary: Opaque clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 × 2 inches or clear bags up to 14 × 14 × 6 inches with at most two pockets are allowed. Inspected medical and diaper bags are exceptions.
allowed: Clear bag up to 14 × 14 × 6 inches with two pockets maximum
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Advance parking reservations are strongly advised because paid parking near the arena is limited. Downtown shuttles for concerts cost $10 per person, boarding at Liberty and Barnard Streets.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The dedicated rideshare pickup and drop-off area is Lot B; drivers enter from West Gwinnett Street.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food, drinks and containers are prohibited, except items for infants such as baby bottles and formula. Food and drinks are sold inside.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: All building entrances have wheelchair-accessible ramps; contact an arena attendant for assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The arena prohibits re-entry after leaving, except for any explicitly announced event exception.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The ticket office opens three hours before showtime on event days. VIP will-call tickets follow the tour’s pickup instructions and are not distributed by the arena ticket office.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors usually open 60 or 90 minutes before showtime according to the specific listing. Most events use mobile tickets displayed with a QR code on a phone.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
